note: Per-fixture allowlist of EXPECTED layout-diff check failures (lib/expected-failures.mjs). A listed failure does not make layout-diff/run.mjs exit 2 and does not fail the gate. The expiry is enforced: when a listed check passes, run.mjs exits 2 and the gate fails with 'allowlist entry expired' until the entry is removed. Adding an entry needs a reason with evidence and an expiry condition; it never hides an input-parity failure that invalidates attribution without saying so (attribution_valid stays false and Chrome-referenced verdicts keep their caveat).
